topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I can't believe this just happened. My car, gone, just like that. Pulled right out of my driveway, as if I don't even have a right to park there. The nerve. Now I'm left here, a note on my door telling me to call some impound lot. Like I have time for this. I’m supposed to be heading out, and now I’m stuck dealing with bureaucracy and endless phone calls. Really, what kind of system does this? My plans, my calm, all shattered by a misplaced sticker or an overlooked sign. Just great.
